about.title: Farmersville Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Farmersville is a small town, and when someone dies here because another person was careless, the loss is felt on every block. Public records show one traffic death in Farmersville during 2025, alongside 19 injury collisions and 28 people hurt, with the highest collision counts along W Visalia Road, Visalia Road and the Farmersville Boulevard corridor. Behind a number like that is a family sorting through funeral bills, a missing paycheck, and an empty chair at dinner. California law gives certain relatives the right to bring a wrongful death claim. A surviving spouse or domestic partner and children come first; if none exist, other dependents or heirs may qualify. The claim is a civil matter, separate from any criminal charges the district attorney may or may not file. You have two years from the date of death to act, and much less if a city, county or state agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We connect Farmersville families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.title: The full picture of loss

items.question: Someone in my family was killed on Farmersville Boulevard. Do we have to wait for the criminal case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and runs on its own track, separate from anything the Tulare County District Attorney decides to do. Your family can move forward whether or not criminal charges are ever filed. Waiting for a criminal outcome can also eat into the two-year civil deadline, so it is worth asking an attorney early.

items.question: My parent died and there was no spouse. Can adult children bring the claim?
items.answer: Yes, children of the person who died are among the first in line to file under California law, regardless of their age. If there is no spouse, domestic partner or children, certain dependents or heirs may be able to step in. An independent attorney can sort out who should be part of the case so nothing is left out.
